hybrid.input: source poses, event phase and world goals
hybrid.output: blended full-body poses plus IK trajectories

procedural.input: guard pose, phase, direction, intensity and targets
procedural.output: full-body control for uppercut, block, dodge, pursuit, impact impulse and persistent recoil step

fall_reaction.input: final knockdown contact, compatible backward-fall FBX, ground plane
fall_reaction.output: blended falling poses with standing IK released, ground correction and final pose held; no get-up or ground combat

external_model.contract: Must output Beta-compatible local poses, source FPS, contact/stance phases; validate before registration
